title: Le corps
intro: 25 words for the body, from head to toe. To say something hurts, French uses **avoir mal à** + the body part: *j'ai mal **à la** tête, **au** dos, **aux** pieds*. And with body parts, French often says **le, la, les** instead of *my*: *je me lave **les** mains*.

words.def: Toute la personne : la tête, les bras, les jambes…
words.def_en: The whole person: head, arms, legs…

examples.fr: Le **corps** humain a deux cent six os.
examples.en: The human body has two hundred and six bones.

examples.fr: J'ai mal partout, dans tout le **corps** !
examples.en: I ache all over, my whole body!

examples.fr: Le sport, c'est bon pour le **corps** et pour la tête.
examples.en: Sport is good for the body and the mind.

words.note: The **ps** is silent: /kɔʁ/. Same spelling in the plural: **les corps**.

words.def: La partie du corps en haut, avec les yeux, le nez et la bouche.
words.def_en: The top part of the body, with the eyes, nose and mouth.

examples.en: I've got a headache.

examples.fr: Lou met un chapeau sur sa **tête**.
examples.en: Lou puts a hat on her head.
Turn your head to the left.

words.note: **avoir mal à la tête** = to have a headache. **faire la tête** = to sulk.

words.def: Le devant de la tête : les yeux, le nez, la bouche, les joues.
words.def_en: The front of the head: eyes, nose, mouth, cheeks.

examples.en: She has a pretty face.
Wash your face!
I know that face…

words.note: **le visage** is masculine, even though it ends in -e.

words.def: Ce qui pousse sur la tête. On les coupe chez le coiffeur.
words.def_en: What grows on your head. You get it cut at the hairdresser's.

examples.en: Léa has long hair.

examples.fr: Il y a un **cheveu** dans ma soupe !
examples.en: There's a hair in my soup!
I brush my hair.

words.note: **les cheveux** is plural in French: *mes cheveux **sont** longs* (my hair **is** long).

words.def: On voit avec. On en a deux.
words.def_en: You see with it. You have two of them.

examples.en: She has blue eyes.
Close your eyes!
I've got something in my eye.

words.note: Irregular plural: **un œil** /œj/ → **des yeux** /jø/, with a liaison: *les‿yeux* /le.zjø/.

words.def: On entend avec. Il y en a une de chaque côté de la tête.
words.def_en: You hear with it. There's one on each side of the head.

examples.en: The rabbit has big ears.
Lou has an earache.

examples.fr: Il me dit un secret à l'**oreille**.
examples.en: He whispers a secret in my ear.

words.def: Au milieu du visage : on sent les odeurs avec.
words.def_en: In the middle of the face: you smell things with it.

examples.en: Pinocchio has a very long nose!
My nose is running.

examples.fr: Ne mets pas tes doigts dans le **nez** !
examples.en: Don't pick your nose!

words.note: The **z** is silent: /ne/. Same spelling in the plural: **les nez**.

words.def: On mange, on boit et on parle avec.
words.def_en: You eat, drink and talk with it.

examples.en: Open your mouth!

examples.fr: On ne parle pas la **bouche** pleine.
examples.en: You don't talk with your mouth full.

examples.fr: Il a du chocolat autour de la **bouche**.
examples.en: He has chocolate round his mouth.

words.def: Le bord de la bouche, en haut et en bas.
words.def_en: The edge of the mouth, top and bottom.

examples.en: She has red lips.
Inès is putting on lipstick.
He bites his lip.

words.def: Les deux côtés du visage, sous les yeux.
words.def_en: The two sides of the face, under the eyes.

examples.fr: Elle a les **joues** rouges : elle a froid.
examples.en: Her cheeks are red: she's cold.

examples.fr: Il fait un bisou sur la **joue** de Lou.
examples.en: He gives Lou a kiss on the cheek.

examples.fr: En France, on se fait la bise sur les deux **joues**.
examples.en: In France, people greet each other with a kiss on both cheeks.

words.def: La partie du corps entre la tête et les épaules.
words.def_en: The part of the body between the head and the shoulders.

examples.fr: La girafe a un très long **cou**.
examples.en: The giraffe has a very long neck.
Put your scarf round your neck.
My neck hurts.

words.def: Là où le bras commence, en haut.
words.def_en: Where the arm starts, at the top.

examples.fr: Il porte son sac sur l'**épaule**.
examples.en: He carries his bag on his shoulder.

examples.fr: Lou dort sur l'**épaule** de son père.
examples.en: Lou is asleep on her father's shoulder.
My shoulders hurt.

words.def: La partie du corps entre l'épaule et la main.
words.def_en: The part of the body between the shoulder and the hand.

examples.fr: Il prend le bébé dans ses **bras**.
examples.en: He takes the baby in his arms.

examples.fr: Elle a un tatouage sur le **bras**.
examples.en: She has a tattoo on her arm.
I broke my arm.

words.note: Same spelling in the plural: **les bras**.

words.def: Le milieu du bras : là où le bras plie.
words.def_en: The middle of the arm: where it bends.

examples.en: No elbows on the table!
He nudges me with his elbow.

examples.fr: Je me suis fait mal au **coude**.
examples.en: I hurt my elbow.

words.def: Au bout du bras, avec cinq doigts. On prend les choses avec.
words.def_en: At the end of the arm, with five fingers. You pick things up with it.

examples.en: Wash your hands before eating!
He writes with his left hand.
Hold my hand to cross the road.

words.note: **la main** is feminine. **serrer la main** = to shake hands.

words.def: Une des cinq petites [parties|partie] au bout de la main.
words.def_en: One of the five small parts at the end of the hand.

examples.fr: On a cinq **doigts** à chaque main.
examples.en: We have five fingers on each hand.
Lou counts on her fingers.
I've cut my finger!

words.note: The **gt** is silent: /dwa/. **les doigts de pied** = toes.

words.def: Le milieu du corps, devant : la nourriture y va.
words.def_en: The middle of the body, at the front: that's where food goes.

examples.fr: J'ai mal au **ventre** : j'ai trop mangé !
examples.en: I've got a stomach ache: I ate too much!

examples.fr: Minou dort sur le **ventre** de Sophie.
examples.en: Minou is asleep on Sophie's tummy.
My stomach is empty.

words.def: La partie du corps derrière, des épaules jusqu'aux jambes.
words.def_en: The part of the body at the back, from the shoulders down to the legs.

examples.en: My back hurts.
I sleep on my back.

examples.fr: Il a un tatouage dans le **dos**.
examples.en: He has a tattoo on his back.

words.def: La partie du corps entre le ventre et le pied ; on marche avec.
words.def_en: The part of the body between the belly and the foot; you walk with it.

examples.en: She has long legs.

examples.fr: Il s'est cassé la **jambe** au ski.
examples.en: He broke his leg skiing.

examples.fr: J'ai mal aux **jambes** : on a beaucoup marché !
examples.en: My legs hurt: we walked a lot!

words.def: Le milieu de la jambe : là où la jambe plie.
words.def_en: The middle of the leg: where it bends.

examples.fr: Lou est tombée : elle a mal au **genou**.
examples.en: Lou fell over: her knee hurts.
He kneels down.
The cat is asleep on my lap.

words.note: Plural with **x**: **des genoux**. **sur mes genoux** = on my lap.

words.def: Au bout de la jambe : on marche dessus.
words.def_en: At the end of the leg: you walk on it.

examples.en: I walk to work.
My feet are cold.
Ouch! You're standing on my foot!

words.note: **à pied** = on foot. **les doigts de pied** = toes.

words.def: Ce qui couvre tout le corps, dehors. Aussi : ce qu'on enlève d'un fruit.
words.def_en: What covers the whole body, on the outside. Also: what you take off a fruit.

examples.en: She has very fair skin.

examples.fr: Mets de la crème solaire sur ta **peau** !
examples.en: Put sun cream on your skin!

examples.fr: On ne mange pas la **peau** de la banane.
examples.en: You don't eat the banana peel.

words.def: Il est dans le corps et il envoie le sang partout. Aussi : là où sont les sentiments.
words.def_en: It's inside the body and sends blood everywhere. Also: where feelings live.

examples.en: My heart is beating very fast!
She's kind-hearted.
I love you with all my heart.

words.note: **par cœur** = by heart: *apprendre par cœur*. **avoir mal au cœur** = to feel sick.

words.def: Le liquide rouge dans le corps.
words.def_en: The red liquid in the body.

examples.fr: Lou a du **sang** sur le genou.
examples.en: Lou has blood on her knee.
I don't like seeing blood.
He gives blood at the hospital.

words.note: The **g** is silent: /sɑ̃/, the same sound as **cent** and **sans**!

words.def: Une partie [dure|dur] dans le corps : on en a deux cent six.
words.def_en: A hard part inside the body: we have two hundred and six of them.

examples.en: The dog is eating a bone.

examples.fr: Il s'est cassé un **os** du pied.
examples.en: He broke a bone in his foot.

examples.fr: Le lait, c'est bon pour les **os**.
examples.en: Milk is good for your bones.

words.note: **un os** /œ̃.nɔs/. In the plural, people say **des os** /de.zɔs/ or /de.zo/.

story.title: Le monstre de Lou
story.en: Lou falls over in the park, then draws a very strange monster.

lines.fr: Mercredi après-midi, au parc. Lou court, et… boum ! Elle tombe.
lines.en: Wednesday afternoon, at the park. Lou is running, and… bang! She falls over.

lines.fr: Papa ! J'ai mal ! Il y a du sang sur mon genou !
lines.en: Daddy! It hurts! There's blood on my knee!

lines.fr: Montre-moi… Ce n'est pas grave, ma puce. Juste un petit trou dans la peau.
lines.en: Show me… It's nothing serious, sweetie. Just a little hole in the skin.

lines.fr: À la maison, Paul met un pansement. Puis Lou fait un dessin, pour oublier.
lines.en: At home, Paul puts a plaster on. Then Lou does a drawing, to forget about it.

lines.fr: Regarde, Papa, c'est un monstre ! Il a trois yeux et quatre oreilles.
lines.en: Look, Daddy, it's a monster! It has three eyes and four ears.

lines.fr: Quatre oreilles ? Il entend bien, alors ! Et son visage est tout vert…
lines.en: Four ears? He must hear well, then! And his face is all green…

lines.fr: Oui, et il a un gros nez rouge, une grande bouche et des lèvres bleues.
lines.en: Yes, and he has a big red nose, a big mouth and blue lips.

lines.fr: Il n'a pas de cheveux sur la tête, mais il a des poils sur les joues !
lines.en: He has no hair on his head, but he has fur on his cheeks!

lines.fr: Et ce long cou ? On dirait une girafe !
lines.en: And that long neck? He looks like a giraffe!

lines.fr: Il a six bras, avec une main au bout de chaque bras… et dix doigts à chaque main !
lines.en: He has six arms, with a hand at the end of each arm… and ten fingers on each hand!

lines.fr: Ça fait beaucoup de doigts ! Et ces deux ronds, sur ses épaules ?
lines.en: That's a lot of fingers! And those two circles on his shoulders?

lines.fr: Ce sont ses coudes. Ils sont sur ses épaules, parce que c'est un monstre !
lines.en: Those are his elbows. They're on his shoulders, because he's a monster!

lines.fr: Il a un gros ventre plein de bonbons, un dos tout vert et des jambes très courtes.
lines.en: He has a big belly full of sweets, a back that's all green and very short legs.

lines.fr: Et ses pieds ? Il n'a pas de pieds ?
lines.en: And his feet? Doesn't he have any feet?

lines.fr: Non, il vole ! Et il a un chien. Le chien mange un os.
lines.en: No, he flies! And he has a dog. The dog is eating a bone.

lines.fr: Et il est gentil, ce monstre, ou méchant ?
lines.en: And is this monster nice, or nasty?

lines.fr: Très gentil ! Regarde : il a un grand cœur rouge sur le corps. Et il a mal au genou, comme moi !
lines.en: Very nice! Look: he has a big red heart on his body. And his knee hurts, like mine!

lines.fr: Paul sourit et met le dessin sur le réfrigérateur.
lines.en: Paul smiles and puts the drawing on the fridge.
